title: Identifying the Peerless band photograph
summary: Looking at the Peerless band picture, they discuss who led it and identify the Gaspards, Piron, Charlie McCurdy, and Andrew Kimball as trumpeter.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I was wondering if we saw that picture, of course, that Russell copied of the Peerless band. And I understand that Bab Frank and McCurdy were sort of the leaders of that at one period. Do you remember who was really the leader at the time your father played? Of this particular band? Yes, that picture you have.
I don't really remember who was the leader of the band, but most of the time in the days when he was playing the trumpet player always was leading the band.

Most of the time the trumpet player was the leader of the band, but I really don't remember. But I know some of the fellas on there, I think he has the name of them, the guys who, the name of the fellas.

We were wondering once who the trumpet player was, and I wonder if somebody thought it might be Manuel Perez, but... It's Andrew Kimball. I was going to say Andrew Kimball was supposed to be the trumpet player with...
I think, this is not Manuel Perez.

No, I don't think so. This is not Manuel. I've seen them. I know the fellas I know on here, I know, well, this fella here. Excuse me, I know... This is... Yeah, Oak Gaspar and Vic Gaspar. I know them. I know P. Ron. Oh yeah, that's right.
Yeah, and this fella here, for a while I thought it was Pico, but it's not Pico.
Charlie McCurdy. Right. Right. That's who that would be, Charlie McCurdy. Now this fella playing trumpet, I don't know if that could be Freddie Kepin. I was wondering if that was Freddie Kepin.

Yeah, Kimball was supposed to be. It's too bad, I should have had a copy of this. I interviewed Norv and Henry Kimball, Henry Kimball Jr., some people call him. Because his father is a bass player, Henry Kimball. He used to play on the boat with Fade Marable and all.

And a long time people used to think that this Andrew Kimball wasn't any member of the family, but he was sort of a half-brother or something. He was related to the... considered an uncle of his. Yeah. He didn't know that even at first when he was a boy until his father told him about it later. So he would have recognized him, I'm sure, but he would have shown him that picture.
Well at the time I was such a youngster I couldn't remember.
